title: Radiation dose
text: The app adds each day's dosimeter reading to a running total and shows it as a share of the 600 mSv career limit (NASA-STD-3001 Vol. 1 Rev. B). There is no single-reading colour: the number informs planning, not alarms.
High-rate alarms come from the spacecraft radiation monitor, not from this app. Follow the mission shelter plan on any such alarm.
